mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by >2% in a month but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and discount rates increase.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by >10% y-o-y but SPX 60-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) rises by more than 300,000 in a month, it signals a rapidly tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises by >300k in a month
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises by >300k but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) falls by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: RSAFS falls by >1% m-o-m but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3%, it signals an inflationary regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
